notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/9db3211fe64302f314f33ffdbe6299ce5e1e3211.gif
Hi all!
Update 9 is live!

NEW LEVELS AVAILABLE!
With this update we introduce 10 new extra levels that we couldn't fit in the original game experience: hope you’ll enjoy them!!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/700be72172fca24dee50db1ef67bf2d237bc78d3.png
KITES IN THE SKY
The flying kites make their appearance! We’ve had them in mind for a while – the most attentive of you might have noticed them in the game’s art – but didn’t have a chance to introduce them since now. If you feel free like the wind or you want to give your dragons some company, give them a try.

RUSSIAN LOCALIZATION
Russian is now available for everyone and the efforts to localize the game continue day and night thanks to our amazing community!

notes.title: MEANDERS - Summer Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e4cd008ab332796c4dbfc578a63e5121ebc1b48c.gif
Hi all!
Update 8 is live!

INTRODUCING... BEACH BALLS!!
To kick Summer in the right direction and celebrate the awesome Summer Sales we introduce... the Beach Ball skin!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/7b94dc4ed537989e2de882e67a07a96cf41be45c.png
NEW "SHARPEN" VISUAL FILTER
You like clarity and sharpness when you play? Well, this visual filter is for you!

WORLD MODES POSTPONED
Due to the recent feedback, we have decided to indefinitely postpone MEANDERS World Modes.

We have removed the corresponding tab from the Atomic Stuff Menu since both modes are going to be reworked from scratch, in order for them to achieve a more interesting gameplay that differs significantly from the main game.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/64e8d43cdfd23b259e350a53058077f8acd19b0a.png
At the same, we didn't completely remove the current code from the game so, if you want to give the discarded "Pimp My Meanders" mode a try - to see how it looked like or to give us your feedback - you can:
1. Press F10 while in-game to open the Console
2. Type the command "pimp" to either enable or disable this mode (works only if used while in the pause menu).

Thanks!

LOCALIZATION UPDATE
Our translation and localization efforts continue, thank you all for the support so far!
Updated: Catalan, Czech, Danish, Dutch, German, Hungarian, Spanish, Ukrainian
New: Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified), French, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e9c8502f6c66330e69c7771c6033034c961493e9.png

CHANGELOG 1.8.1
*Added Beach Ball Skin
*Added Sharpen Visual Filter
*Now a Speedrun can be restarted instantly after its completion without having to wait for the Rankboard opening
*The "Reset" shortcut key can now be used to restart a Speedrun even on the Rankboard Menu
*Fixed a bug with Serious Meanders' "Air Blast" cooldown timer when pausing the game
*Fixed a bug with medals unlocking on level 40
*Improved gamepad and mouse navigation for the Main Menu
*Improved visibility for Main Menu buttons
*Improved Main Menu titles alignment and sizes

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.notes:

Hi there all!

Update 6 is live!

"ONE SHOT, ONE HIT" DIFFICULTY MODE AVAILABLE
With this mode active, EVERY BALL needs to hit something “meaningful” (a crystal/bullseye/ring or a bubble/balloon) … otherwise, if the ball touches the water, a wall, a barrier or else… the level will reset!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/5b0e06d172e27aec82ea73c3b5afb418c7e71a60.png
LANGUANGES UPDATED
Huge update for the game localization! The following languages have been updated:
Catalan, Czech, Dutch, German, Hungarian, Spanish, Ukrainian

The whole localization system is still work in progress, so if you find any errors or problems please let us know!
If you would like to help with other languages, even just a bit, here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

Overchunked OUT NOW!
Yes, the Kaiju family expands since during the last month, we worked on a new game!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/833910/Overchunked/

Overchunked is a game about a giant circular saw constantly moving forward: steer it left and right to guide its course, dodge obstacles, TNT explosives and destroy the rest of the environment to obtain points!
If you enjoy small-yet-solid games with simple mechanics, Overchunked could be what you are looking for.

*Added "One Shot, One Hit" Difficulty Mode

*Fixed the wrong location of a Teleport in Level 31
*Fixed a bug when hitting a timed platform with a crystal ball
*Fixed the wrong collision for Holes' step
*Carried momentum of Bouncers through reset should now be fixed
*Carried momentum of Cannons through reset should now be fixed

notes.title: MEANDERS - SPEEDRUN MODE Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/dacfec8ea3775939606b399932db7712914e7d5c.gif

Hi there all!

Update 5 is live!

SPEEDRUN MODE & STEAM LEADERBOARDS AVAILABLE
Speedrun Mode is finally here! 🎈🎈🎈
It can be started at any moment, even if you haven't yet completed the game or unlocked that specific level you wish to run.

However, completing a level during Speedrun Mode does not unlock it.
This means that the base game progress and the Speedrun Mode are completely separated.

While the Speedrun mode is enabled you will not able to:
*Access the "Select Meander" menu
*Access the "Atomic Stuff" menu
*Use the "God Room" shortcut button
*Use the "Restart Journey" shortcut button

Once you exit Speedrun Mode you automatically return to the level you were before starting the run.

Bouncers Route and Cannons Route Speedrun
When reaching crossroads, "wrong" exits will be disabled, forcing you to follow the selected path.

All Levels Speedrun
When reaching crossroads, it does not matter which exit you choose, you are forced to follow the "basic" levels progression (1 to 40)

There are two kinds of Leaderboards currently implemented: "ATOMIC STUFF ON" and "ATOMIC STUFF OFF"

CHANGELOG 1.05.8
*Added Speedrun Mode
*Added Steam Leaderboards Integration
*Revamped all game textures
*Fixed a bug with beam's particle system
*Fixed a bug with Cannon Gun charged bomb while resetting
*Slight change to Portals collision to improve instant teleportation
*Slight change to Teleports collision to improve instant teleportation
*The game now saves every time a Portal is crossed (to prevent annoying rollbacks)

DIFFICULTY MODES IMPLEMENTATION
Future updates are going to be focused on adding all the three remaining DIFFICULTY MODES we have designed.
Keep yourself posted 😉

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: MEANDERS - SECRET ENDING Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/966c55ec9a49a80e44f3f714482c5f1727d6d4fb.gif

Hi there all!

Update 4 is live!

SECRET ENDING AND GOD MODE AVAILABLE
Have you ever felt that sudden urge to smash the chatty GOD ball you find at the end of the game? WELL, NOW YOU CAN!
Thanks to the secret ending introduced with this update, you will be able to even the score with the flying fellow AND to obtain a secret game mode: the GOD MODE.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/fdc7292ba14b62629d88f00bb351f9d3023e45fa.gif

Different from all other game modes, the GOD MODE is a progressive mode and will get increasingly stronger each and every time you reach the secret ending.

LOCALIZATION CONTINUES
The game localization is going on, we really can't thank you enough for all the support!
For this update, we introduce Czech, Danish, and Ukranian.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/2d605b704387e4ef4135359f384954149624c0eb.gif

Keep in mind that the whole localization system is still work in progress, so if you find any errors or problems please let us know.
If you would like to help, even just a bit, here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

CHANGELOG 1.04.5
*Fixed a bug with the "JumpMaxHoldTime" when resetting a level
*Fixed a sound bug with Slides
*Fixed a bug with the selected Language save system
*Fixed a bug with the graphics settings save system
*Enabled CCD for ringed Targets
*Enabled CCD for Slides
*Improved horizon colors
*Improved the Pistol Gun Burst Fire (NMS mode)
*Improved camera animation with the GOD
*Water no longer destroys the ball while you are holding it
*The "Meander Cleared" status is now reset when starting a new journey
*Added Ukrainian, Czech and Danish languages
*Major fixes to the localization system
*Minor UI improvements

SPEEDRUN MODE WITH LEADERBOARDS
For all the speedy fellows out there, the SPEEDRUN mode is coming!!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/c09b1c248ae88c826a9a2b63bbeb2b1ac5df62d8.gif

This mode will add an in-game timer and will be activable for:
- Individual levels
- Specific Routes (Cannon path/Bouncer path)
- All levels (a full game run)
Of course, the whole system will be integrated with the Steam leaderboards!

MEANDERS - GOD'S PACK
Together with this update, a limited bundle offer to get MEANDERS and it's beautiful Soundtrack at a discounted price! http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6257

notes.title: MEANDERS - DRAGONS Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/d65de1cda0f16a631a5a93afb8059b380453c336.gif

Roaring greetings to ya all!

Update 3 is live!

DRAGONS AVAILABLE
Happy New Lunar Year to you all! For this special event, we thought of inviting over our cousins - the Chinese dragons - to play. You can activate/deactivate DRAGONS from the visual stuff menu, hope you find them super-cool! In the future we'll make other additions, such as UFOs and Kites... look forward to them!

MULTIPLE LANGUAGES ENABLED
We introduced the languages already translated by some incredible members of this community, a round of cheers for them all!
All languages are Work In Progress and will be tested thoroughly, but we thought of making them already available so that everyone could play them. If you have some feedback let us know!

It's not even been two days since we posted our announcement [link] asking for your help in translating the game... and so much has been translated already, really happy about that *faith in humanity over 9000*

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/7bd882459cfbe69300610769182d4154cfaf2141.gif

Of course, we will continue to fix them and introduce other languages, so if you would like to help - even just a bit, no need to take a whole project on your own - here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

SHORTCUT TO THE GOD
We added a shortcut button to reach the "god room", it makes getting to the final room so much faster!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e767527f91798e027c90ba8ef5f3170057b1b9c7.gif

The shortcut button will appear in your menu if you have already reached the final room in the current playthrough.

CHANGELOG 1.03.1
*Dragons Enabled
*Multiples languages enabled for testing purposes (French, Spanish, German, Polish, Simplified Chinese)
*Added a handy button in the main menu to easily reach the god room (you have to visit it at least one time during the current run to enable this button)
*Increased the texture pool size
*Visual improvement for Height Fog
*Fixed the audio bug in Level 17 "Slider-Bouncer"
*Fixed collision response between bouncers and physics objects
*Fixed a bug with charged ball while opening the pause menu
*Minor UI improvements

SECRET ENDING IN THE WORKS
We are now working on the finishing touches of MEANDERS not-so-secret ending (which we had to postpone due to our early launch): it will be announced soon!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/68f8be0371b2cbf95dce659273ec1a04cbf20429.gif

MEANDERS DRAGONS BUNDLE
Together with this update, there is a limited bundle offer to get MEANDERS and it's beautiful Soundtrack at a discounted price! http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6257

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: MEANDERS - DRY SOULS Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/6022588a5ad59e1414e608aa0eecd67cdccb2dfa.gif

Hi there all!

Update 2 is live!

DRY SOULS GAME MODE AVAILABLE
Let us introduce the first Game mode meant to increase difficulty: Dry Souls!
Once enabled, you will "die" and respawn every time you fall into the water. Be careful!!
Reach the Exit of a level with Dry Souls enabled and you will receive a shiny Medal!

DIFFICULTY MODES AND MEDALS
Say what? Dry Souls is not difficult enough for you?! Well, that's awesome!
With future updates we will introduce three new DIFFICULTY MODES, all with their own Medals!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/e352d9d33d73350f0755319ef1c8d58bafaecad4.gif

Each DIFFICULTY MODE will be playable as stand-alone, but it will also be possible to stack several (if not all) of these modes together to increase difficulty EXPONENTIALLY and create the ULTIMATE CHALLENGE.

CHANGELOG 1.02.3
*Fixed a bug when using "Select Meander" while the character is inside a cannon
*Fixed the unlocking of all the "Meander Cleared" related achievements
*Fixed the cannon gun bug when entering a cannon al full charge (Serious M mode)
*Fixed the cannon gun bug when opening the pause menu at full charge (Serious M mode)
*Fixed the "Black" UI color theme which was in fact, Grey.
*It is no longer possible to spawn mini-cannons on Collapsers (timed platforms) (Serious M mode)
*Moving Targets on Level 24 "Towered" will now reset to their original position when the level is reset

NEW VISUAL STUFF
To celebrate the upcoming Lunar New Year we will introduce...Dragons!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/a56f079b9d51d64a93b58bf82d57c48b0e9795af.gif
Coming February 16th!

Hi there all!

Update 1 is live!
Nothing special, it just fixes some bugs and stuff 😉

CHANGELOG 1.01
*Added an option in the game settings to enable a Blob Shadow for the character.
Cheers to Maghook for the suggestion!
*Fixed a teleporting bug with falling "Collapsers" (timed platforms)
*Slight change to level 15 "Tryangle": Exit platforms are now easier to reach
*Slight change to level 8 "Teleports": added direction arrows to hint at teleport destination
*Enabled CCD (Continuous Collision Detection) for rail cannons platforms

NEW GAME MODE
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/57a6cc37dad75ab15f42f1a670416469cc030209.gif
We would like to officially announce the next game mode: DRY SOULS!
Coming February 13th!

Features:
✔️Water Contact = Level Reset
✔️Prepare to get wet
❗ Ragequit Intensifies
❗ Difficulty Increases

SOUNDTRACK
Following your feedback, we uploaded MP3 files version for our Original Soundtrack in addition to the uncompressed WAVs.
We also set correct metadata for all the MP3 tracks: now if imported in software like iTunes they are detected!

Well, that's all for now...till the next update!!

Best,

notes.title: MEANDERS - Post Launch Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/1335dfc0df598fc6d4debd95d889e9573cd0bd71.gif

Hi there all!

Update 1 is live!
Nothing special, it just fixes some bugs and stuff 😉

CHANGELOG 1.01
*Added an option in the game settings to enable a Blob Shadow for the character.
Cheers to Maghook for the suggestion!
*Fixed a teleporting bug with falling "Collapsers" (timed platforms)
*Slight change to level 15 "Tryangle": Exit platforms are now easier to reach
*Slight change to level 8 "Teleports": added direction arrows to hint at teleport destination
*Enabled CCD (Continuous Collision Detection) for rail cannons platforms

NEW GAME MODE
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31239236/57a6cc37dad75ab15f42f1a670416469cc030209.gif
We would like to officially announce the next game mode: DRY SOULS!
Coming February 13th!

Features:
✔️Water Contact = Level Reset
✔️Prepare to get wet
❗ Ragequit Intensifies
❗ Difficulty Increases

SOUNDTRACK
Following your feedback, we uploaded MP3 files version for our Original Soundtrack in addition to the uncompressed WAVs.
We also set correct metadata for all the MP3 tracks: now if imported in software like iTunes they are detected!

Well, that's all for now...till the next update!!

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH
